listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (Zelda-Mobile (OJZen/totk-mobile))
listing.summary: Build Tears of the Kingdom from your own game and its 1.4.3 update on an Apple silicon Mac. The project reports playable scenes and working saves on Mac. It also reports limited iPad play and an iPhone reaching the title screen.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Put one copy of the base game, one 1.4.3 .nsz update and matching prod.keys in local/games/. The project checks module fingerprints and refuses other versions.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build locally on an M1 or later Mac with full Xcode, Command Line Tools and Homebrew. The project offers no ready-made package or Intel Mac build.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The Mac build can stutter when shaders first load. The mobile observations cover limited play and import on M1 or later iPads and the title screen on iPhone 15 Pro. A complete playthrough and exact macOS and Metal minimums remain unconfirmed.
